resources.string: Samsung TTS isn\'t the preferred engine
For TalkBack and other apps to use these voices, choose Samsung TTS as the preferred engine in the text-to-speech settings.
Send usage statistics and error reports?

To help improve the app, Samsung TTS can send usage statistics and error reports to Google Firebase.
• Usage statistics: the screens you open, the voices you choose or play, and whether a voice loaded and how long it took
• Error reports: what went wrong when the app crashed or couldn't load a voice, and which voice was in use
Both include your device model, Android version and approximate region. The text being spoken is never sent.

You can change this at any time at the bottom of the language list.
